question: Can an environment-scoped SQLite Durable Object preserve one reservation and one reward intent across concurrency, lost acknowledgements, crashes, broadcasts, and chain reorganizations?
method: Pin and run the local Cloudflare SQLite Durable Object runtime without deployment.
Model a unique input reservation, immutable request content, one operationId per request, signed raw transaction persisted before broadcast, and finalized-chain reconciliation.
Exercise concurrent same/different requests, lost save acknowledgement, lost broadcast acknowledgement, restart, reorg, and stale revision; record raw responses and DB snapshots.
Probe AES-256-GCM nonce generation, AAD revision binding, and ciphertext alteration rejection inside local workerd.

Start two independent Node processes sequentially against the same local SQLite persistence directory; verify reservation, request, raw transaction, uncertain phase, and duplicate rejection after restart.
acceptance: In the target local runtime, atomic uniqueness must reject conflicting input and request writes; retry must return the original operation and raw transaction; uncertain broadcast/reorg must prevent new distribution and UTXO reuse. A model test only establishes these invariants for that model; chain integration and full production code remain separate.
